summary: Hey #clmooc team, @inoreader raised prices by 150% to be able to build a feed of all our poetry, photographs and art for our web ring. I need to figure out a new way to build an RSS Planet. Any ideas anyone ever use @cogdog's tutorials? #IndieWeb
